blocks.html: Here is a very strange case: that the most private and particular friends that Martin Guerre had had in his young age should have been placed in such error that they took the said du Tilh for the same Guerre. True it is that the best of it is more astonishing still — to hear that the near kinsfolk, even the four sisters, were in the like error; and more prodigious still, and almost incredible, that the said Bertrande de Rols, wife of the said Martin Guerre, having lived and conversed ten or twelve years with the same Martin Guerre her husband, should have had a like blindfold before her eyes.
